analysis.aggregate: For each pre-registered ratio, report all three block values plus median and min-max; do not compute a p-value or population interval.
analysis.fixed_reference: Secondarily report each Elastic arm relative to its within-block Fixed arm.
analysis.observed_metric_source: For each arm, resolve exactly one *.container_resources_summary.json and run the observed_metric_jq_filter against it after sampler validation.
analysis.primary_comparison: Within each block compare elastic_command_end/elastic_current using wall_time_s, observed_cpu_core_seconds, observed_memory_gib_seconds, total_reserved_cpu_core_seconds, and total_reserved_memory_gb_seconds.
analysis.treatment_check: From lease_events.jsonl, separately count applied cpu_resized events with reason=low_util_no_throttle and reason=command_end_idle_reclaim. Do not use aggregate cpu_shrink_events as the treatment measure.
analysis.workload_diagnostic: Report adaptive-rejection-sampler elapsed_s and its applied CPU grow, low-util shrink, and command-end reclaim counts per arm as an explicitly outcome-informed secondary diagnostic.

claim_scope: Outcome-informed c4 mechanism diagnostic on the same eight development traces. The schedule balances ordinal position but not transition or carryover; it supports no population claim.

execution.command_expansion: For each run, take the selected arm_command_templates argv array and replace the single {output_dir} element with the run output_dir string; do not insert, remove, split, or join any other argv element.
execution.retry_policy: No automatic retry. Stop on any command or gate failure, preserve evidence, and remove only exact residual objects created by the failed arm.
execution.stop_condition: Stop immediately if a command exits nonzero or any required after-arm or after-block gate fails.

policies.sole_intentional_difference: elastic_command_end sets in_command_cpu_shrink_enabled=false; all other resource-manager, pool, token-service, and executor values match current.

preflight_gates: The base Free design, manifest, and tasks SHA256 values match the explicit hashes in this design.
The source trace repository commit matches this design and has no changes to the eight locked trace paths.
The eight source trace SHA256 values and eight Docker image IDs match the maps in the hash-locked base Free design.

The ASB worktree is clean after committing this design; all ASB paths other than this design match asb_code_commit. The EAR worktree is clean at the locked EAR commit, and both EAR policy SHA256 values match this design.

A structural comparison of the two policy YAML objects shows exactly three differing paths: name, docker.resource_manager.policy_id, and docker.resource_manager.in_command_cpu_shrink_enabled (default true versus explicit false).
No container or sweep fixed image recorded by a prior arm in this experiment remains.

after_all_blocks: Report all three block values plus median and min-max exactly as pre-registered; do not combine any earlier replay result.
Report treatment checks separately from performance outcomes.
after_each_arm_before_next_arm: The command exits zero and throughput reports attempted=completed=8, failed=0, action_count=142, llm_call_count=75, and tool_exec_count=67.
The arm has 67/67 replay tool outcomes matched and zero mismatches.
The arm has one monitored container per completed trace, at least two samples and positive sample-window duration per container, and no sampler errors or drops.
The arm has valid EAR lifecycle artifacts with zero OOM kills, admission rejects, and resize rejects.
Fixed uses mode=fixed and the current policy SHA; each Elastic arm uses mode=elastic and its locked policy SHA.
Fixed has zero cpu_resized lease events with reason=low_util_no_throttle and zero with reason=command_end_idle_reclaim.
elastic_current has at least one applied cpu_resized lease event with reason=low_util_no_throttle; otherwise stop because the block has no treatment exposure.
elastic_command_end has zero applied cpu_resized lease events with reason=low_util_no_throttle and at least one with reason=command_end_idle_reclaim.
No task container ID or sweep fixed image name recorded by this arm remains.
after_each_block_before_next_block: The three throughput summaries have the same 142 actions, 75 LLM calls, 67 tool executions, source trace entries, and replay configuration.
The three mismatch reports have 67/67 matched outcomes, zero mismatches, and the same normalized-output match pattern.

Expand and run both plot_command_templates with this block's three exact arm directories and block=block-N. The distinct output directories must each contain ear_timeline.png, ear_fixed_vs_elastic.png, and ear_comparison.json.

The pair plot JSONs provide wall and reserved metrics only. Compute observed CPU and memory metrics separately with observed_metric_jq_filter; do not attribute observed metrics to the pair plot output.
